Hero.tag: Senior Frontend Engineer · 7+ years of experience
Hero.sub: Specialized in React & Next.js. Focused on growth, conversion optimization, A/B testing, and high-performance design systems.

About.headlineStart: Driving product growth right from the
About.sub: I'm Florencia Scavone, a Frontend Engineer working at the intersection of UI design and frontend engineering.
About.secondSub: Over the past 7 years on the Growth team at CookUnity, I learned that a great interface must not only look stunning—it needs to be finely tuned to convert, scale, and delight users. My approach pairs Figma’s aesthetic precision with the technical rigor of Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Experience.description: Led frontend development for the main acquisition funnel (homepage, landing pages, and onboarding flows), working closely with product, design, and backend engineering teams.

highlights.title: Next.js App Router Migration
highlights.description: Incrementally migrated landing page architecture from Pages Router to App Router with zero downtime, driving measurable Core Web Vitals improvements.

highlights.title: Dynamic Promotion Engine
highlights.description: Built a centralized promotional engine using React Context and custom priority logic to render real-time discount rules across high-traffic landing pages.

highlights.title: Homepage Rebuild & Rebrand
highlights.description: Spearheaded the frontend rebuild of the core homepage during a global rebranding, introducing dynamic feature targeting using Unleash.

highlights.title: A/B Testing & Experimentation
highlights.description: Shipped dozens of experiment variants across onboarding funnels, integrating GraphQL endpoints and Redux state management to validate conversion hypotheses.

highlights.title: Design System & UI Library
highlights.description: Architected and maintained the internal UI component library using Atomic Design principles and Storybook, significantly speeding up cross-team development.

highlights.title: TypeScript Migration
highlights.description: Guided the codebase transition from JavaScript to TypeScript, enhancing developer experience and drastically cutting runtime errors in production.

Projects.title: New side-projects coming soon
Projects.sub: I'm currently documenting and refining my latest personal projects and case studies.
Projects.highlightBoxSub: In the meantime, you can explore my recent work leading frontend architecture and growth experiments directly on CookUnity's live platform.
